title: 第十七章 引狼第十八章 突变
lines: 岳峰送走了大兄，回到县衙才发现傅游艺竟然回来了，瞧这老小子一脸矜持的样子，岳峰便知道这一次去东都他应该收获不菲。
“岳兄弟，此去东都，县尊大人可是把你往贵人那边引荐了，只是眼下东都是多事之秋，你的事情究竟能否成现在还不能料定！
不过，纵然事有不成，你还年轻，将来的机会也很大，你万万不要气馁，你瞧瞧我，年过六旬依旧还力争上游，不敢稍有懈怠啊！”傅游艺道，他用手捋着颔下的几根胡子，神情非常的矜持。
岳峰道：“傅大人这一次定然有极大的收获，吾在此恭喜大人，贺喜大人！大人刚刚走马上任，便能大有斩获，这是大好的兆头！”
“哈哈！”傅游艺哈哈大笑，老怀大开，道：“算不上什么斩获，这是天后圣明，欲要广开言路，提拔人才不拘一格！我也不过是补了一个门下省的拾遗而已。这个位置可是重担在肩，我这把老骨头不知道能不能干好这份差事呢！岳兄弟，你还要帮我啊！”
傅游艺言辞非常的诚恳，心情却是大好，岳峰的每句话都说到了他的心坎上。他走马上任不过二十多天，便得到了天大的好处，他心中哪里能不激动？
所谓补缺拾遗，这都是中书和门下省的官职，这两个官的品阶都不高，可是却有资格直接上书皇帝，仅此一点，就足够傅游艺欣喜若狂了。
傅游艺一直在等待机会，现在机会就在眼前了，之前还万事俱备欠东风，现在顺利补了拾遗的官，他终于可以大干一场了。
岳峰也很惊讶，没想到傅游艺竟然捞到了这等好处，一时对这个老家伙的前途更有信心了！看来历史还是沿着原来的轨迹在前进，岳峰的出现不仅没有阻挠傅游艺的前途，反而助力傅游艺更加的高歌猛进了。
下一步傅游艺是要上书劝进了么？岳峰心中这么想，总觉得事情似乎没那么简单，傅游艺应该还有一番套路，不知道在这个过程中，岳峰是不是能继续成为傅游艺的助力。
傅游艺的心情的确很好，这一次东都之行让他意识到岳峰真是他的福将。成功攀上了姚县尊，去一趟东都他竟然真有机会进太平公主府。
傅游艺有了这一番经历，觉得自己前六十年真是活到狗身上去了，现在他顿悟开窍，踌躇满志的要大干一场，在他的布局中岳峰自然是重要关键的人物，所以他回来之后第一个见的人是岳峰。
岳峰的表现也让他满意，两人谈话的气氛非常的融洽，岳峰沉吟了一下又道：“对了，傅大人，县尊大人和您是一起回来的么？”
傅游艺摇头道：“县尊大人在东都故人很多，还得缓几天才能回来，我先行回来办好公务，这个时候我们合宫县的公务可万万不能懈怠啊！”
岳峰微微愣了一下，心想姚云生竟然没有回来？他什么时候能回？岳峰忽然感到有些不妙。
因为眼下合宫县衙的局面，其根源在于姚云生在镇场子，在这个背景下才有了周柔取代县尉魏生明，才有了傅游艺迅速站稳脚跟，才有了六房书吏翻身扬眉吐气。
现在姚云生竟然去东都不返，合宫县的局面能撑得住？魏生明虽然被压制，内心必然不服，他一直在窥探机会，想扭转乾坤呢！
姚云生在县衙，他惧于姚云生的背景可能还需要缓图，现在姚云生留在东都，他必然会立刻动手，傅游艺现在得意忘形，恐怕要出大事。
岳峰无疑是敏锐的，因为他多年的军旅生涯和各种黑恶势力打交道很多，对恶人的心思吃得很透，就在岳峰和傅游艺说话的时候，在另外一个地方，魏生明和燕二也在说话。
“嘿嘿，真是天助我也，姚云山这个纨绔，肯定在东都迷上了平康坊的姑娘，要么便是进了赌坊，以他的德行，没有两三月不得返回！现在这个时候，我们正是动手的良机！”魏生明脸上的神情极其的阴狠，他那清秀的面庞上，尽是杀机浮现。
燕二道：“大人，现在机会是不错，但是该怎么出手却也有大学问，傅游艺这个老东西这一次可是捞了大好处了，轻易不好动啊！”
魏生明嘿嘿冷笑道：“燕二啊，这些事儿还用我们自己动手么？我听说你和那个姓强的小子有过节，正好，这一次这个过节便能了呢！
武公子你认得么？最近他找不到好的货色了！正好，我修书一封过去，回头你负责安排，那姓强的小子内人据说姿色很不错，定然能入武公子的法眼，他们一旦成事，你还怕事情不精彩？”
燕二盯着魏生明，忽然伸出手指头道：“高，大人真是高。可是姓强的只是小卒，关键是那个姓岳的招人厌！”
魏生明道：“先让姓岳的一帮人自己内部离心离德，至于岳峰这小儿，其来历已经清清楚楚，就是梓泽乡的一田舍儿而已，先把县衙里的事情解决，回头要对付几个田舍儿还不是易如反掌？”
魏生明脸色愈发的阴狠，几乎是咬牙切齿的道：“姓岳的这个小儿，我绝对不会轻易放过。他让我受辱，我要让他全家死光！”
魏生明豁然站起身来道：“燕二，武公子是什么身份你应该知道，这一次他来我们合宫县，倘若你能把他给陪好了，你还愁没有前途？所以，机会我给你了，能不能把握好就看你自己了！”
燕二愣了一下，旋即脸上浮现出狂热之色，道：“大人放心，我燕二一定唯大人马首是瞻！一定帮大人办好差事！”
魏生明哈哈大笑，道：“好，有你这句话大事可成！老虎不发威，被人当成了病猫了，嘿嘿，现在机会来了，说什么也不能辜负！”
魏生明说罢，取出一个木匣子，木匣子打开，里面竟然是满满一匣子的黄金，他取出几块金子扔给燕二道：“你暗中收的那几个人这一次也要派上用场，需要使钱的地方你尽管说，关键时候，钱可一丁点也省不得！”
燕二眉开眼笑的道：“大人好手段，好气魄！那岳峰自诩兄弟义气，却不知道这年头有钱能使鬼推磨，一个田舍儿跟大人您斗，那简直是鸡蛋碰石头，这一次他死定了……”
content_en:
Yue Feng saw off his eldest brother, and when he returned to the county government office, he discovered that Fu Youyi was back. Seeing the reserved look on this old boy's face, Yue Feng knew that he should gain a lot from this trip to Dongdu.
"Brother Yue, when you go to Dongdu, the county magistrate has recommended you to the nobles. However, Dongdu is currently in trouble, and it is still uncertain whether your matter will be successful or not!
However, even if things fail, you are still young and will have great opportunities in the future. Don’t be discouraged. Look at me, I am still striving for the top in my sixties and don’t dare to slack off! Fu Youyi said, stroking a few beards under his chin with his hands, looking very reserved.
Yue Feng said: "Master Fu will definitely gain a lot this time. I would like to congratulate you and congratulate you! You have just taken office and you will achieve a lot. This is a good sign!"
"Haha!" Fu Youyi laughed heartily, and said: "It's not really an achievement. This is the Queen of Heaven, who wants to spread his voice and promote talents of all kinds! I'm just filling in for a subordinate. This position has a heavy responsibility on my shoulders. I don't know if I can do this job well with my old bones! Brother Yue, you still have to help me!"
Fu Youyi's words were very sincere, but she was in a good mood. Every word Yue Feng said spoke to his heart. He had only been in office for more than 20 days, but he had received huge benefits. How could he not be excited?
The so-called "filling in the gaps" are the official positions of Zhongshu and Menxiasheng. These two officials are not of high rank, but they are qualified to write directly to the emperor. This alone is enough for Fu Youyi to be ecstatic.
Fu Youyi has been waiting for the opportunity, and now the opportunity is right in front of him. Before, everything was ready and he owed something to Dongfeng. Now that he has successfully filled in the gaps, he can finally do something big.
Yue Feng was also surprised. He didn't expect Fu Youyi to get such benefits, and he became more confident in this old guy's future! It seems that history is still advancing along the original track. Yue Feng's appearance not only did not hinder Fu Youyi's future, but helped Fu Youyi to advance even more.
Next step is Fu Youyi going to write a letter to persuade him to join? Yue Feng thought so in his mind, and felt that things were not that simple. Fu Youyi should have some tricks up his sleeve. I wonder if Yue Feng could continue to be Fu Youyi's help in this process.
Fu Youyi was indeed in a good mood. This trip to the Eastern Capital made him realize that Yue Feng was really his lucky general. After successfully climbing up to Yao County Zun, he actually had a chance to enter Princess Taiping's mansion during a trip to Dongdu.
After this experience, Fu Youyi felt that he had really lived like a dog in the first sixty years. Now he had an epiphany and was ambitious to do something big. Yue Feng was naturally an important and key figure in his plan, so the first person he met after coming back was Yue Feng.
Yue Feng's performance also satisfied him. The atmosphere of the conversation between the two was very harmonious. Yue Feng pondered for a moment and then said: "By the way, Mr. Fu, did the county magistrate and you come back together?"
Fu Youyi shook his head and said: "The Lord County Lord has many old friends in Dongdu, and it will take a few days before he can come back. I will come back first to handle the official business. At this time, we in Hegong County must not slack off in our official business!"
Yue Feng was slightly stunned, thinking that Yao Yunsheng didn't come back? When can he come back? Yue Feng suddenly felt something was wrong.
Because the current situation in Hegong County Government is rooted in the fact that Yao Yunsheng was in the town hall. It was under this background that Zhou Rou replaced the county captain Wei Shengming, Fu Youyi quickly gained a foothold, and the six-room clerk stood up and became proud.
Now that Yao Yunsheng has gone east without returning, can the situation in Hegong County be sustained? Although Wei Shengming was suppressed, he must have been dissatisfied. He had been snooping for opportunities and wanted to turn things around!
Yao Yunsheng is in the county government, and he is afraid that Yao Yunsheng's background may need to be eased. Now that Yao Yunsheng is staying in Dongdu, he will definitely take action immediately. Fu Youyi is now getting carried away, and something big may happen.
…
Yue Feng is undoubtedly keen, because he has dealt with various evil forces in his military career for many years, and he has a good understanding of the evil people's thoughts. While Yue Feng and Fu Youyi were talking, in another place, Wei Shengming and Yan Er were also talking.
"Hehe, God is really helping me. This dandy Yao Yunshan must have fallen in love with the girl from Pingkangfang in Dongdu, or he has entered a gambling house. With his virtue, he will not be allowed to return for two or three months! Now is the perfect opportunity for us to take action!" The expression on Wei Shengming's face was extremely vicious, and his delicate face was filled with murderous intent.
Yan Er said: "Sir, the opportunity is good now, but there is still a lot of knowledge about how to take action. This old guy Fu Youyi has reaped huge benefits this time. He is so easy to move!"
Wei Shengming sneered and said: "Yan Er, do we still have to do these things ourselves? I heard that you had a feud with that boy named Qiang. It just so happens that this time we can just celebrate the festival!"
Do you recognize Mr. Wu? He can't find any good stuff lately! Just in time, I'll send you a copy of the book, and you'll be responsible for the arrangements later. The wife named Qiang is said to be very good-looking, and she will definitely be able to catch Mr. Wu's eye. Once they succeed, are you still afraid that things won't be exciting? "
Yan Er stared at Wei Shengming and suddenly stretched out his finger and said: "Gao, sir, you are really tall. But the one named Qiang is just a pawn. The key is that the one named Yue is annoying!"
Wei Shengming said: "Let the group of people named Yue become alienated among themselves first. As for the boy Yue Feng, his origin is already clear. He is just a farmhouse in Zize Township. Let's resolve the matter in the county government first. Isn't it easy to deal with several farmhouses later?"
Wei Shengming's face became more sinister, and he almost gritted his teeth and said: "I will never let this boy named Yue go easily. He humiliated me, and I want his whole family to die!"
Wei Shengming suddenly stood up and said: "Yan Er, you should know who Mr. Wu is. This time he comes to our Hegong County. If you can accompany him, are you still worried that you have no future? So, I have given you the opportunity. It depends on you whether you can seize it!"
Yan Er was stunned for a moment, then a look of fanaticism appeared on his face, and said: "Don't worry, Sir, I, Yan Er, will only follow your lead! I will definitely help you complete your errands!"
Wei Shengming laughed loudly and said: "Okay, with your words, great things can be accomplished! If a tiger doesn't show its power, it will be regarded as a sick cat. Hey, now the opportunity has come, I can't let it down no matter what I say!"
After Wei Shengming finished speaking, he took out a wooden box. When the wooden box was opened, it turned out to be a box full of gold. He took out a few pieces of gold and threw them to Yan Er and said, "Those people you secretly recruited will also come in handy this time. Just tell me where the money is needed. At the critical moment, you won't be able to save any money!"
Yan Er said with a smile on his face: "My lord, you are so resourceful and courageous! That Yue Feng prides himself on brotherly loyalty, but he doesn't know that money can make all the difference these days. If a farmer fights with you, it would be like an egg against a stone. This time he is dead..."
